events.verdict: Jackson (IND) initiates contact with Randle's (MIN) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Bradley (IND) briefly places both hands on Randle (MIN), who raises his arms in response but the contact does not affect his FOM.

Toppin (IND) places his off-arm against DiVincenzo (MIN), who contests the driving shot attempt in a vertical position. Toppin braces for the ensuing contact, but does not extend his off-arm into DiVincenzo to affect his ability to contest.
Bradley (IND) has an arm extended in Edwards' (MIN) path, which he moves through.
Walker (IND) reaches in and initiates illegal contact to Edwards' (MIN) arm during the drive, which causes him to lose control of the ball.
DiVincenzo (MIN) attempts to save the ball and it touches McConnell's (IND) elbow before going out of bounds. Possession should be given to Minnesota instead of Indiana.
McConnell (IND) and DiVincenzo (MIN) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
McDaniels (MIN) jumps alongside of McConnell (IND) to the basket and avoids making any illegal contact during the driving shot attempt.
Toppin (IND) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
McConnell (IND) and McDaniels (MIN) make incidental foot contact with each other in the backcourt.
Bryant (IND) firms up in a screening position in Conley's (MIN) path and does not deliver contact.

Replay review of the foul called on Edwards (MIN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Edwards (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Bryant's (IND) possession. The ball is loose at the point of interruption and because neither team was in imminent possession of the ball, play resumes with a jump ball at center circle.
Jackson (IND) jumps forward into Edwards (MIN), initiating contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Jackson (IND) briefly has an arm around Edwards' (MIN) side, but releases and allows him to move freely.
Jackson (IND) reaches in and initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) legally contests Toppin's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Bryant (IND) moves along with Randle (MIN) to the basket and briefly has a hand positioned on his back, which he immediately removes as Randle starts his upward shooting motion.
Bryant (IND) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Randle's (MIN) arm.
